description: This script automates the configuration of iOS signing settings, including team ID detection, bundle ID normalization, and generating a local configuration file for signing.

methods.name: sanitize_identifier_segment
methods.description: Sanitizes a raw string to produce a normalized identifier segment, converting to lowercase, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with dashes, and trimming dashes.

methods.name: normalize_bundle_id
methods.description: Normalizes a raw bundle ID string to lowercase, replaces invalid characters with dashes or dots, and trims trailing dots or dashes.
